summary: Sanctus backend tested end-to-end via pytest (25/25 passed). Verified health, liturgical calendar (Ordinary Time Friday abstinence, Good Friday 2026, Easter 2026, Christmas, Ash Wednesday, month view with Lent->Easter transition, validation errors), unauthenticated 401s, authenticated flow via direct MongoDB session seeding, preferences default + persistence, Claude Sonnet 4.5 meal & workout generation, Friday abstinence guardrail (no chicken/beef/pork/etc. in dinner), Sunday rest content guardrail, retrieval endpoints + week endpoints, ObjectId (_id) exclusion in every returned doc, and logout removing the session.
critical_code_review_comments: liturgical.py defines `laetare` and `gaudete` locals that are computed but never used/returned (dead code in the season branches around lines 239 and 248). Not a blocker, but rose-Sunday detection for Laetare is never applied.
server.py uses @app.on_event('startup' / 'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI in favor of the lifespan context manager. Works today; consider migrating.
auth_logout returns {'ok': True} even when no Authorization header is supplied — quietly OK but worth a 401 to be consistent with the rest of the auth surface. Minor.
_chat_json raises 502 if Claude returns non-JSON; consider a single retry with a stricter 'reply with JSON only' prompt to harden against the occasional model deviation.
seed_data_creation: Inserted user_id=test_user_1 (email test@sanctus.app) and session_token=test_token_abc into MongoDB collections users + user_sessions via a session-scoped pytest fixture. Cleanup deletes the seeded user, session, preferences, meals, and workouts on test session end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env (note: not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Auth uses Emergent Google Sign-In; for headless tests, seed users + user_sessions directly in MongoDB and pass `Authorization: Bearer <session_token>`. AI generation (Claude Sonnet 4.5) takes ~5-15s per call — use 90s timeouts. Friday abstinence guardrail in the meal prompt is working; the AI returns fish-based dinners on 2026-02-13. Sunday workout guard returns rest/gentle/walk content for 2026-02-15. Tests are idempotent and clean up after themselves.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. The Catholic-themed liturgical logic in liturgical.py matches expectations for all probed dates including the moveable feasts derived from Easter 2026 (Apr 5).
